title: What Roles Do System Prompts Really Assign? Validating and Steering Occupational Role Vectors in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.15989v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Applications built on large language models assign the model a role through its system prompt, intending to shape how it responds for their use case. We introduce a validation framework for extracting and injecting occupational role vectors, activation-level directions that capture how someone in a given occupational role would distinctively respond to a task or question. We validate these vectors through two complementary lenses, on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. The interpretability lens asks whether each vector is a stable, separable, domain-consistent representation of its role: extracted vectors are highly reproducible across repeated runs and sampling temperatures, remain separable even for very similar roles, and agree more with themselves across in-domain and out-of-domain questions than with other roles' signal. translated_title: 系统提示词究竟赋予了什么角色？验证与引导大语言模型中的职业角色向量
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型构建的应用通过系统提示词为模型赋予一个角色，意图使模型的响应方式符合其特定的使用场景。我们提出了一个用于提取和注入职业角色向量的验证框架——职业角色向量是激活层面的方向，能够刻画处于某一特定职业角色的人会如何独特地回应某项任务或问题。我们在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct两个模型上，通过两个互补的视角对这些向量进行验证。可解释性视角关注每个向量是否是其对应角色的稳定、可分离且领域一致的表示：提取出的向量在多次重复运行和不同采样温度下具有高度可复现性，即使对于非常相似的角色仍能保持可分离性，并且这些向量在领域内和领域外问题上与其自身的一致性高于与其他角色信号的一致性。控制视角关注在生成过程中注入角色向量是否能使模型表达该（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个职业角色向量的验证框架，从可解释性和控制两个互补视角证明：从激活中提取的职业角色向量既是稳定、可分离、领域一致的角色表征，又可以通过注入有效引导模型在生成过程中呈现特定职业角色的行为。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a validation framework for occupational role vectors, demonstrating through interpretability and control lenses that these activation-level directions serve as stable, separable, domain-consistent role representations that can effectively steer LLM behavior when injected during generation.
